summary: SOLCAP is a KeyState tax-credit syndication platform expressed through separate pooled LLCs, not an operating PortCo jointly owned with Generate. Generate is the sponsor/developer/owner of underlying solar assets, while KeyState administers pooled tax-equity capital. SEC filings confirm multiple distinct 2024-2026 investment vehicles and omit Generate as their manager. The SOLCAP row should therefore be excluded from the active manager-level PortCo list.
nonblockingDisclosureGaps: Investor identities, tax-allocation economics, flip dates, recapture expirations and purchase options are not publicly disclosed.
The exact Fund X link to SOLCAP Generate 2025 LLC and the project mappings for 2026-A/B are not publicly confirmed.
Corner Power's role after the 2024 vehicle is unresolved.
